Traders Thank PM Modi in Open Letter Over Gold Price Drop

A traders' body has thanked Prime Minister Narendra Modi in an open letter, attributing a significant drop in gold prices to his advice. The letter states that had they ignored the Prime Minister's advice, they would have faced debt, and that Modi Ji saved lakhs from debt. The price of gold reportedly fell by ₹65 lakh per kg.
